title: Śrī Kṛṣṇa-vandanā
author: Sanskrit composition by Śrīla Rūpa Goswāmī Prabhu

translation: O Lord, I offer my respectful obeisances to You. May you place the bumblebee of my mind in the honey of Your lotus feet.

text: yady api samādhiṣu vidhir api paśyati
translation: Although Brahmā in his samādhi cannot obtain a glimpse of even a ray of the tips of the nails of Your feet, still, O Achyuta, having heard of the waves of Your astonishing mercy, I yearn to see You.
O Mādhava, although I do not have even a sesame seed of devotion for You, Your supreme power can make even the impossible become possible.
O eternal Lord, may the bumblebee of my mind, finding there the most wonderful sweetness, eternally stay in the honey of Your lotus feet, which rebuke the sweetest nectar.
